items.name: Speedcube Baja Open 2023

venue.name: [El Trompo Museo Interactivo Tijuana](http://www.eltrompo.org)

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdllxIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b16c4555cf884b977f59734b9b046b263e1339d8/image.png)

**Speed Cube Baja Open 2023 es la séptima competencia oficial realizada en la ciudad de Tijuana en el estado de Baja California**
La edición de este año está especializada en weas por lo que Skewb es la categoria principal de esta competencia.
> Este evento es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia.


**Baja Open is the seventh official competition held in Tijuana, Baja California**
In this year's edition, the competition specialized in side events, so Skewb is the main event.
> This event is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) prior to the competition.

items.name: OH-io State 2023

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

items.information:
#### This competition does not feature 3x3x3 Cube. The main event is 3x3x3 One-Handed
As a result, this competition is not recommended for those looking for a typical competition experience. However, new competitors are still welcome to sign up :)
Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

items.name: CubingUSA Great Lakes FMC Championship 2023
items.information:
This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. For a more normal comeptition experience, check out [CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesChampionship2023).

Podiums and champions from this competition will be recognized at [CubingUSA Great Lakes Championship 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreatLakesChampionship2023) during the award ceremony.

This competition will take place at several different venues across the Great Lakes region. Check out the Location Tab for more details.
